**Triage: `repo:objectui` · `pm:blocked` on #17250 · `priority:p2` · type Bug. ⛔ No `domain:*` — that is objectui's triage to produce once the card lands there.**

A card list that cannot be scrolled once the grid collapses to cards is a **pure objectui defect**: strip objectstack out of the report and it still stands. ⇒ SKILL.md rule 1 says it lives in the repo its fix lands in, and that is `objectstack-ai/objectui`.

### ⚠️ Why it is not moved right now

Two measured facts:

1. **A seat cannot transfer an issue in this container.** GraphQL is refused outside a pinned PR-review set (*"This GraphQL query is not enabled for this session"*) and REST has no transfer endpoint. Measured this round.
2. **The move is already ruled and queued.** #17250 carries a director-seat ruling (option **A**) and sits `pm:awaiting-maintainer` with a `Maintainer-action:` line: *transfer every non-seam `repo:objectui` card … re-read `label:repo:objectui` first*.

⇒ ⛔ This seat does **not** rebuild the card in objectui — that would pre-empt a ruling whose whole point is that transfer keeps the number and the thread. ⇒ instead it is **labelled into the batch the maintainer is about to move**, and the `Blocked-by:` line is appended to the body so the unlock scan can see it.

⭐ The `Maintainer-action:` line's *"re-read `label:repo:objectui` first"* clause is what makes this safe: a card added to the label after the count was taken is picked up automatically.

⇒ Once it lands in objectui, its triage assigns `domain:ui` and a queue state. ⚠️ **The two screenshots are the reproduction** — ⛔ do not close for lack of repro steps.

`Size/model suggestion:` S–M, once it is in the right repo.

## Moved to objectstack-ai/objectui#10128 — closing `duplicate`

Triage seat (`session_01KYzNJPin9Ar4oMMkSh4S9h`), 2026-09-20T12:54Z. Executing the letter-**A** ruling on #17250 (「issue 住在修复落地的仓」) under the maintainer's 2026-09-20 approval of the hybrid split.

**Nothing here is declined.** The work continues at **objectstack-ai/objectui#10128**, which carries this card's full text, its grade and its type unchanged.

### Why recreated rather than transferred

GitHub's issue transfer exists only in GraphQL, and this container's egress refuses it: `POST https://api.github.com/graphql` answers **403** 「GitHub GraphQL is not available from Claude Code sessions」. The REST API has no transfer endpoint at all — `POST /repos/…/issues/…/transfer` answers **404**. Both measured this round, ⛔ not recalled. ⇒ `SKILL.md`〈多仓协调〉's fallback applies verbatim: 「transfer 不可用时重建:出处头 + 裸 `#N` 改全名 + 关源单为 moved」.

### ⛔ This thread is not lost

This card is **closed, not deleted** — everything written here stays readable at this URL, and the new card's body header points back to it by number. The move was priced on exactly that: of the 27 cards in the recreate batch, every carried comment was read first and all of them are PM routing/grading comments, ⛔ none is irreplaceable evidence. The six cards whose threads *do* carry evidence are being hand-transferred losslessly by the maintainer instead.

`state_reason: duplicate` ⇒ the new card is the same issue in the repo that owns it. ⚠️ GitHub's REST `PATCH /issues` accepts a `duplicate_of` field and then **silently ignores** it (200, field still null — measured twice), so the machine-readable pointer could not be set from this channel; **objectstack-ai/objectui#10128** is the pointer, in prose.
